Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study uses a hybrid approach: discovery-based DDA (Orbitrap Velos) to identify kinases and targeted SRM (TSQ Vantage) for quantification. While DDA was used for initial identification, the primary goal and the bulk of the data described relate to the SRM targeted assay. No specific PTM-enrichment modifiers from the provided ontology (like phospho or ubiquitin) were used for the final routing, although kinases were enriched using ActivX probes.

scope: Using ActivX nucleotide analogues (desthiobiotin-ATP and -ADP), we enriched nucleotide binding proteins and identified isolated proteins by data-dependent analysis on an Orbitrap Velos.
Cells were washed in PBS, lysed in PLC buffer, enriched for nucleotide binding proteins using ActivX desthiobiotin-ATP or ADP, separated by SDS-PAGE and gel bands cut.
Lysates were enriched using ActivX and the relative ratio of all validated proteotypic peptides were compared in a pairwise manner.
